name: Belmond Villa Sant’ Andrea
insider_take: Perched dramatically on Taormina Mare's pristine bay, this aristocratic villa has been enchanting discerning travelers since 1950 with its exclusive private beach and panoramic views of Mount Etna.
whats_special: This former private villa boasts the only private beach club in Taormina, accessible via a scenic funicular railway. The hotel's terraced gardens cascade down to crystal-clear waters, while each room offers breathtaking views of either Mount Etna or the Ionian Sea. The property's intimate scale of just 71 rooms ensures personalized service in an authentic Sicilian palazzo setting.
pro_tip: Book dinner at the hotel's terrace restaurant during sunset for unobstructed views of Mount Etna's silhouette against the golden sky – it's considered one of Sicily's most romantic dining experiences.
dont_miss: The ancient Greek Theatre of Taormina, just a 10-minute walk uphill, offers spectacular performances against a backdrop of the sea and Mount Etna. Also explore the charming medieval streets of Taormina's historic center, lined with artisan boutiques and traditional Sicilian cafés serving authentic granita and cannoli.
pros: Historic villa with authentic Sicilian charm and character
Prime beachfront location in picturesque Taormina
Luxury Belmond hospitality and personalized service
Stunning Mediterranean Sea views and coastal setting
cons: Limited availability due to boutique size
